mapper.select: UPDATE agent_task_queue t SET status = 'dispatched', dispatched_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE t.id = ( SELECT c.id FROM agent_task_queue c WHERE c.status = 'queued' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM agent_task_queue a WHERE a.issue_id = c.issue_id AND a.agent_id = c.agent_id AND a.status IN ('dispatched','running') ) ORDER BY c.priority DESC, c.created_at ASC, c.id ASC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF c SKIP LOCKED ) RETURNING t.id, t.workspace_id, t.issue_id, t.agent_id, t.runtime_id, t.status, t.context, t.trigger_comment_id, t.priority, t.created_at
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_task_queue SET status = 'completed', result = #{result}::jsonb, completed_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('dispatched','running')
UPDATE agent_task_queue SET status = 'failed', error = #{error}, failure_class = #{failureClass}, completed_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('dispatched','running')
mapper.select: SELECT issue_id FROM agent_task_queue WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_task_queue SET session_id = COALESCE(#{sessionId}, session_id), input_tokens = #{inputTokens}, output_tokens = #{outputTokens}, cost_usd_ticks = #{costUsdTicks}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('dispatched','running')
